signature_moves: The entire app is the signature: import the iPhone Dynamic Island onto the MacBook notch, using a TRUE-BLACK opaque material so software fuses with the physical black notch/bezel into one perceived object (Gestalt figure-ground closure) — the same trick iPhone uses with its OLED cutout

Icon = the product literally: a thick black display-bezel squircle glowing purple->magenta->pink from within (the island's content aura); the aura hue is reused as the marketing highlight and demo wallpaper for one coherent identity
defects: Deliberate non-native surface (signature, not anti-pattern) — occupies the system menu-bar/notch chrome zone, ignores the user's accent color, uses no native control grammar; systematic + purposeful + accessible per defect-vs-signature, so recorded as signature but EXCLUDED from macOS canon (lineage gate)
No system-accent binding (controlAccentColor) — defensible for a true-black island but the one place a native reading diverges
Evidence poverty (not a design defect): 1 surface / 1 state from a marketing render — no grid reference, no expanded/live states, no dark-vs-light-desktop robustness, no settings/onboarding surface

aesthetic.direction: iOS Dynamic Island transplant — a custom consumer-utility surface (outside the range-map families); the marketing wrapper is separately Apple-keynote-mimetic (bold grotesk + cream + marker highlight + platform badge)

psychology: Jakob's Law (inverted) — deliberately leans on users' iPhone Dynamic Island mental model rather than Mac conventions; borrows a cross-device familiarity instead of being conventional to macOS
Law of Pragnanz / figure-ground closure (Wertheimer) — true-black island + black notch merge into one perceived object; this Gestalt fusion is the app's core perceptual mechanism
Peripheral vision / Von Restorff (Weinschenk) — the salient dark island at the top edge sits in peripheral vision and hijacks attention for status/notifications by design
Aesthetic-usability effect (Kurosu & Kashimura) — the polished bezel-merge illusion buys perceived quality on first contact
notes: The ONLY app UI is the window inside cover.png, a stylized marketing composite (2400x1260) — not a captured screenshot, so scale is unknowable and every island metric is a low-confidence ratio/estimate. Everything outside the device frame (cream backdrop, bold headline, pink highlighter, 'Mac' badge, icon+wordmark lockup) is brand evidence, analyzed but never conflated with app-UI tokens. Classification tension for synthesis: NATIVE runtime (notch overlays are native-Swift-dominated; not an Electron idiom) but an entirely iOS-Dynamic-Island visible surface — treat the surface grammar as tells+corrections, not mac canon. This is the corpus's first app (previously only the macOS-27 kit). No promotions possible (single app, non-native surface). Opens a candidate 'notch-island / iOS-transplant utility' cluster with a single member.
